method: Read every tracked HTML file and route configuration from immutable git HEAD. Traverse anchor hrefs, meta refreshes, registered exact aliases, dynamic templates, and both first-party hosts. Do not execute client JavaScript, contact APIs, or treat noindex as access control. Hidden links are counted as source links. Queries/fragments collapse for page connectivity.

caveats: Root /map does not exist at baseline. stats.corvus.gent/map is the visitor map and must retain its host-specific meaning.
Static unreachable does not prove a page is inaccessible: JavaScript, search, authenticated controls, campaign links, and direct visits can expose it.
Canonical tags do not redirect a browser; multiple legacy pages remain live despite declaring other canonical URLs.
The local tools/serve.mjs server does not implement all deployment middleware and redirects.
All tracked HTML pages are inventoried, including private/admin/operator shells; noindex is not access control.
Ignore unrelated untracked public/brand and public/support artifacts.
The 8 unreachable public HTML source routes include 2 aliases (/gabe and /hack/2) whose current destination is reachable; 6 primary public pages are outside the static graph.
